nom: TATCHA The Essence Skincare Boosting Treatment

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin describe the toner as hydrating and comfortable without leaving a tight feeling, though one found it still too drying for her needs after only 10 days.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers repeatedly say most toners sting or dry them out but this one does not irritate, burn, or tighten their skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with acne-prone combination-to-dry skin calls it the missing piece in her routine alongside tretinoin.
segments.oily: A reviewer with oily, sensitive skin and dry patches reports it calmed and smoothed her skin without adding oiliness.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 50s-70s report softer, more even-toned, plumper-looking skin and fewer visible fine lines with regular use.
segments.normal: One long-term user recommends the pairing of essence and moisturizer specifically for normal-to-dry skin.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report smoother texture, plumper look, and reduced appearance of fine lines and wrinkles with regular use, including one who says her skin tone evened out completely; effects are described as gradual, needing weeks of consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness or dehydration report immediate hydration and a soft, non-tight feel after use, with one describing it as a 'cool drink of water'; one dissenting reviewer felt it was just water and did not feel hydrating at all.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness and calmer-looking skin, including one with rosacea who saw improvement after a bad breakout.
concerns.barrier: Several long-time toner-avoiders say this is the first toner that doesn't sting, burn, or dry their skin, describing it as soothing rather than irritating.
concerns.spots: One reviewer noticed sun spots lightening and another says uneven skin tone improved noticeably over time.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin and faster-fading scars/redness; one reviewer with otherwise positive experience of the brand says this specific product caused breakouts for her.
concerns.oiliness: Only one reviewer with oily-sensitive skin comments on this, reporting the product balanced her skin without adding oiliness or dryness.

extraits.texte: Wanted to love it because of the reviews but it smelled like witch hazel and felt like water and did nothing for my face after 10 days of use. Maybe that's not long enough but I couldn't justify the texture like it didn't even feel hydrating it worth adding into my routine. Returned and looking for something else.

extraits.titre: Makes a difference visible pretty quickly
extraits.texte: I have insanely acne-prone skin and had some pretty bad scarringhyperpigmentation The only thing I changed about my skincare routine was adding the essence to it and it's made an insane difference over the last 2-3 weeks My acne has eased up a ton the scars and redness are fading a lot quicker and while my skin is still quite dry it probably would've been drier without it

extraits.titre: A Cool Drink of Water for Sensitive Skin!
extraits.texte: My sensitive dry skin loves this essence! It manages to refine pores and hydrate without drying or irritating my skin Most toners and essences burn my skin and leave it drytight This one is perfect to use after the indigo cleansing balm and to prep for the silk serum!
